market.title: Big Brother 28 — Week 4 Eviction
resolutionNote: Resolves on the live Week 4 eviction episode - whichever of the two nominees gets voted out by the house.
Kalshi's own wording: "If [houseguest] is officially eliminated from Big Brother Season 28 Before Aug 7, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes."
Kalshi-only - Polymarket doesn't list a matching single-week eviction contract for this show, only the season-long winner market.

text: Since she won Head of Household in Week 4, Haley Thogmartin had the power to nominate Drew Campbell, Melody Morris, and Taylor Brown for eviction.
Drew had been playing both sides of the house, and nominating him was a strategic gamble by Haley's alliance since it offers him two chances to save himself.
It was Taylor Brown, however, that won Power of Veto, and so she made it off the chopping block, leaving just Drew and Melody.
Kalshi has Drew as the clear favorite to go, at more than 60%.
marketBrief.author: Owain Flanders
